messages:
sanjay: Heads-up — since the kernel+driver roll last night we're seeing a pile of jobs fall back to socket/NCCL NET on mixed H100/A100 racks. Latency and CPU on the host are spiking.
kevin: ugh. Any nvlink/topo output?
sanjay: Pasting quick probe from one affected node (gpu-node-127):
```
# nvidia-smi topo --matrix
        GPU0    GPU1    CPU Affinity
GPU0     X      NV#0    0-23
GPU1   NV#0      X      24-47
```
sanjay: But NCCL logs show no NVLINK detected and it falls back to SHM->SOCKET chain. dmesg has intermittent nvlink training failures:
```
[  12.345678] nvlink: NVLink 0: link training failed, status 0x28
[  12.345689] nvlink: link retrain attempt 3
[  12.345700] nvlink: link up but topology not ready
```
maria: Are these mixed-gen nodes with different PCIe/firmware combos? we saw similar when a100 firmware mismatched h100.
sanjay: Yes, mixed H100/A100 in the same host pool (we didn't drain them before the driver bump).
kevin: Which kernel and driver version?
sanjay: Kernel 6.6.x, NVIDIA driver 535.34, NCCL 2.19.4
ops: Ticket created: https://go/infra/ISSUE-3145 (infra-bot added label: p2p-regression) :rotating_light:
kevin: Quick triage ideas:
- check `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version` and `dmesg | grep -i nvlink`
- `nvidia-persistenced` restart didn't help?
- try modprobe remove/reload of `nvidia` + `nvidia_uvm` on a test node
maria: Also check `lspci -vv` for the NVLink capability registers — some firmware combos return stale capability bits until a full power-cycle.
sanjay: Tried removing modules, did `rmmod nvidia_uvm && rmmod nvidia` then `modprobe nvidia`, NCCL still sees no p2p for that pod's mapping. A reboot temporarily fixes it on one host but it comes back after some time.
kevin: Could be probe ordering/race during link training post-driver upgrade. If kernel changed link init timing, NCCL's p2p detector might query too early and cache absence.
ops: For immediate mitigation we can:
- avoid scheduling mixed-gen replicas on same job pool (taint+affinity)
- pin the fleet back to driver 535.11 for new nodes until fix
- add a rolling reboot/driver-reprobe job to re-establish NVLink on nodes (costly)
sanjay: Added a temporary node label `no-mix-p2p` and updated scheduler to prefer homogeneous nodes. Going to roll that out cluster-wide for training queues.
maria: Can we also instrument NCCL env vars to force the stack to avoid SHM fallback and keep failed jobs from blasting the network? e.g. `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` is destructive, but `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME` to narrow interfaces might limit blast.
kevin: Agree — try `export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO; export NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=^docker0,lo` on a canary job to observe behavior.
sanjay: Will run canary in staging with those env vars and force job to only use homogeneous nodes.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolling-label-update started for training-nodes pool (job 8721). ETA 15m.
kevin: I've opened a vendor escalation with NVIDIA — sent logs and dmesg from 4 nodes. Ticket NV-65892.
maria: If vendor confirms, we may need a driver patch or kernel boot ordering change. Also let's capture NVLink firmware versions (`nvidia-smi -q | grep -i \"NVLink Firmware\"`) across nodes.
sanjay: Captured firmware map and uploaded to the ticket. Early pattern: nodes that flip have older NVLink FW on A100s paired with newer H100s.
ops: Action items:
- short-term: enforce homogeneous scheduling and NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME on canary jobs (ops + sanjay)
- mid-term: test rollback to 535.11 on subset and measure regression rate (kevin)
- long-term: vendor patch / kernel-driver compatibility fix (kevin + maria)
kevin: I'll follow up on NV-65892 and post any suggested driver/kernel combos. If vendor suggests a repro, we should prepare a tiny repro script to trigger training order race.
sanjay: Thanks — passing to runbooks to keep pressure low on network + schedulers.
maria: FYI, putting a note in the infra runbook about mixed-gen p2p risk and add automatic node labeling if nvlink failures exceed threshold.
ops: closing temporary alert for now, will reopen if net blasts continue. :white_check_mark:
sanjay: Will update thread with canary results in ~30m.
